verdict.rationale: Discord documents an App Directory, a searchable hub where users can browse apps by name, category, or collection. It also documents shareable app profile and store pages, and those apps run as integrations inside Discord servers. Together these cover the core of discovering and adding prebuilt integrations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the admin install/authorize-to-server flow and admin permission controls during install, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
